name: Hardware-Based Volume Ray Casting with Early Termination and Z-Updates
definition: A method for hardware-accelerated volume rendering that exploits programmable graphics hardware features, specifically early z-tests and occlusion queries, to manage ray traversal and termination without waiting for asynchronous delivery.
summary: This hardware-accelerated volume rendering method uses early z-tests and occlusion queries to efficiently manage ray traversal and termination, reducing fragment operations through complex rasterization logic.
